info.title: BEQDesigner pipeline service
info.summary: Scan a library, extract and design BEQ filters for titles chosen by filter, on demand or on a schedule, and follow the jobs that do it.
info.description: Reviewing a design stays in the BEQDesigner app. Every /v1 route needs the bearer token (Authorize, above). `GET /health` says which release this is.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Accept the designer's top pick at least this confident.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Say what would be accepted and change nothing.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: Accepted (or, in a dry run, that would be).

excluded.title: Excluded
excluded.description: Confident enough, but left for a person, and why.

state.title: State
state.description: type state: the job state it entered (or cancelling).

text.title: Text
text.description: type event: the redacted text a person reads.

JobEvent.title: JobEvent
JobEvent.description: One thing a job reported, in order (`seq`); `type` says which fields it has.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the work list's action button would say.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the job itself failed (a title that failed is in the result).

joined_to.title: Joined To
joined_to.description: The run job this one joined: its titles went into that run, and it ends when that run does, with its result.

through.description: Run every stage up to this one that each title still needs. A title waiting for review is never taken past design.

scan_first.title: Scan First
scan_first.description: List the sources before selecting, so new titles are seen.

retry_failed.title: Retry Failed
retry_failed.description: Also run titles whose extraction or design failed before.

scan.description: The scan taken first, if one was.

failed_earlier.title: Failed Earlier
failed_earlier.description: Not tried: failed before with the same source and settings.

unavailable.title: Unavailable
unavailable.description: Not done because something it depends on (the designer, the media storage, JRiver) was unavailable. Not remembered as failed: the next run tries it again.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.description: Why the run stopped before its selection was done, though nobody cancelled it: too many titles in a row met an unavailable dependency.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the job itself failed (a title that failed is in the result).

joined_to.title: Joined To
joined_to.description: The run job this one joined: its titles went into that run, and it ends when that run does, with its result.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Sources to list again, by name; none is all of them.

allow_empty.title: Allow Empty
allow_empty.description: A source that now lists nothing replaces its titles (else it keeps them: an unmounted share).

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Source name -> why it could not be listed (its titles are kept).

needs.title: Needs
needs.description: What the title needs next (any of these).

new_since_scan.description: Only titles first seen by the latest scan.

TitleFilter.description: Which titles: the work list's filters. Every field given must hold; none is every title.
